notes.subject: ובאחת
notes.rationale: 'And at/with one (thing) they are brutish' — verse reads as one clause with v7 in Hebrew numbering; 'at one and the same time' vs 'in one thing (the stock)'.

notes.subject: יבערו
notes.rationale: בער means both 'burn/consume' and 'be brutish' — possible pun on the wooden idols consumed by fire, flattened to 'ba dima' in Sepedi.

notes.subject: moferefere
notes.rationale: הבלים 'vanities/breaths' rendered as 'moferefere' (emptiness); the connection to idols as mere breath is lost.

translation: Gomme ba kopana ka go tee, ba dima gomme ba se nago tlhaloganyo; thuto ya moferefere — sehlare ke sona.
